question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 3.
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 2.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**diseases**" refers to illnesses or health conditions affecting the body. (रोग)
 
• The context of the passage is discussing health issues related to water, specifically mentioning ailments like diarrhoea, dysentery, and cholera, which are all diseases.
 
• The other options: "**sufferings**," "**laments**," and "**distress**" do not specifically refer to illnesses, making them less appropriate in this context.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *India has one of the largest number of cases of diseases__ such as diarrhoea, dysentery, and cholera.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Sufferings (पीड़ा)**: refers to experiences of physical or mental pain, not specific to diseases.
 
• **Laments (शोक)**: refers to expressions of grief or sorrow, not directly related to illnesses.
 
• **Distress (कष्ट)**: refers to extreme anxiety, sorrow, or pain, but not specifically illnesses.
